messages:
maya: Starting prod deploy for orders-service in 10m (change window 22:00-23:00 UTC). Rolling to canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. Pinned image: orders-service:release-2026-03-18-v2.3.7

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled. ID: dep-7892. ETA canary: 10m. Hooks: smoke, latency-check. See runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/backout-orders-service

jonathan: quick note — rollback criteria: error rate > 2% over 5m OR p95 latency regresses >30% vs baseline. Also manual abort if payment flow fails.

sam: Confirmed feature flag off for new-quote flow; will keep off until 100% success. Also will hold DB migration until post-canary.

tina: Oncall monitored. I'll watch logs and traces during canary. If we hit criteria, plan is immediate pin to previous image + disable routing.

maya: Copy. Backout commands in runbook, but adding here:

```bash
# rollback to pinned image
kubectl set image deploy/orders orders=registry.redwood/orders:release-2026-03-18-v2.3.6 -n prod
# scale down canary
kubectl scale deploy/orders-canary --replicas=0 -n prod
# toggle router to previous stable
./ops-tools/switch-route --service orders --to stable
```

jonathan: Also add temporary rate limit reduction to 50rps as mitigation if DB load spikes. I can run that quickly.

maya: I'll trigger canary now. dep-7892 started. @tina please confirm smoke pass.

tina: smoke ok after 2m. p50/p95 look good. No errors reported. :thumbsup: 

sam: Observability: adding a short-lived dashboard with the canary tag. link: https://grafana.local/d/abc123/canary-orders (react :eyes:)

deploy-bot: Canary rollout 10% -> 50% completed at 1799804410. No automated rollbacks.

maya: Proceeding to 100% in 5m if no regressions. Reminder: if we need to backout, follow runbook + leave postmortem note in #postmortems.

jonathan: If we backout, I'll coordinate release notes update and version pin in service-catalog.

tina: Monitoring live. Will call abort in thread if criteria met.

(reacts: maya :rocket:, tina :white_check_mark:)
